title: Minutes of the Committee Meeting, 8 October 2026

headings.text: Minutes of the Committee Meeting, 8 October 2026

key_sentences: The meeting opened at 7.30 pm and the chair welcomed the new members.
The minutes of the September meeting were approved without changes.
The treasurer reported a balance of £2,140 and no unpaid invoices.
Rents for the next year will stay at the current level.
The meeting closed at 9.05 pm and the next meeting will be held on 12 November.

rows: Order the new pump and arrange a fitter
Replace the two taps in the lower field
Post the bonfire notice and update the website
Write to the households at the top of the waiting list

list_items.text: 1.1 Water supply. The committee reviewed the repairs to the main tank and agreed that:
(a) the new pump will be installed before the first frost;
(b) two taps will be replaced in the lower field, namely
(ii) the tap by the compost bins;
1.2 Waiting list. There are now 23 households waiting for a plot.
1.3 Winter rules. The notice about bonfires will be posted on the gate.

furniture: Registered charity · Meetings held at the Pavilion, Mill Lane
notes:
